'''Kathou''' was a location on the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] [[Alderaan]].<ref name="Part I" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi Date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> [[Alderaanian]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] told his daughter [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] that when he was her age he had a plan to live far past Kathou and chase [[purrgil]].<ref name="Part I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kathou was mentioned in the [[Part I|first part]] of the [[2022]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.<ref name="Part I" />
